Biography

Information originating from his clan led us to believe that Smokey was dead... But were the Piranas just lying to mask a darker truth? We traced him to an Aquanis prison. He was wearing the sign of █████████, a likely clue to his change in allegiances... But no, there was more to it than that. Maybe it wouldn't be too far-fetched to think of him as being dead, given what they've done to him. Do the Oculus (AKA the Eye) choose their members by chance? Apparently not. But if Kate recruits new inhabitants for Clint City, why doesn't she go ahead and recruit the new members from the Oculus? Is she not allowed to do this? And if so, who’s in charge? I think I've finally understood why █████████ is dead… (Host 516)
